## Checklist
1. Copy the files from `kubejs` into `kubejs` in your game folder. 
2. Tweak the catalyst in `kubejs/startup_scripts/main.js`
3. Reference that catalyst id in mining recipe yields in `kubejs/server_scripts/main.js`

Built-in catalyst ids can be found [here](../../../src/main/resources/data/create_rns/create_rns/catalyst)
